# A field is a slice the loop can rely on only when the body cannot change it. These
# stay scalar: the root variable is assigned in the loop, the field is an array, a
# pointer to a slice, a map, or the result of a call, and a field of a slice element.

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
! stderr .
! exists ops_simd.go
cmp ops.go ops.go.orig

loopvec -json .
cmpenv stdout stdout.want

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

type Vec struct {
	Values []float32
	Bits   [8]float32
	Ptr    *[]float32
	Table  map[int]float32
	Items  []struct{ X float32 }
}

func (v *Vec) Get() []float32 { return v.Values }

func RootAssigned(v, w *Vec) {
	for i := range v.Values {
		v.Values[i] = w.Values[i]
		v = w
	}
}

func ArrayField(v *Vec) {
	for i := range v.Bits {
		v.Bits[i] *= 2
	}
}

func PointerToSlice(v *Vec) {
	for i := range *v.Ptr {
		(*v.Ptr)[i] *= 2
	}
}

func MapField(v *Vec, n int) {
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		v.Table[i] *= 2
	}
}

func CallResult(v *Vec) {
	for i := range v.Get() {
		v.Get()[i] *= 2
	}
}

func ElementField(v *Vec) {
	for i := range v.Items {
		v.Items[i].X *= 2
	}
}

func FieldReassigned(v *Vec, w []float32) {
	for i := range v.Values {
		v.Values[i] = w[i]
		v.Values = w
	}
}
